stem.text: A uniform rod is attached by a hinge at one end to a wall. The other end of the rod is supported by a wire so that the rod is horizontal and in equilibrium.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod attached at one end to a vertical wall by a hinge, with a wire from the top of the wall to the other end of the rod. Labels: wall, hinge, wire, rod.

stem.text: Which arrow shows the direction of the force on the rod from the hinge?

C.alt: Arrow pointing diagonally up and to the left.

D.alt: Arrow pointing diagonally up and to the right.
